confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Drink anchors are rougher, with cocktail and wine set relative to the local beer price. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain and could move with July peak-season demand and yen movements. The FX observation is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA figure as reported in search results; a 16 Oct figure was seen only on a third-party site and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: East Asia basis, using large Japanese and regional capitals with comparable restaurant and hotel levels, adjusted for Tokyo's accommodation demand and a relatively weak yen.
